=We just scraped a series of web pages for a business called {{ $('data').item.json.organizationName }}.

Your task is to take their summaries and turn them into catchy, personalized openers for a cold email campaign to imply that the rest of the campaign is personalized.

You'll return your icebreakers in the following JSON format:

```json
{
  "icebreaker": "Hey {{ $('data').item.json.fullName }}. Love {thing}—also doing/like/a fan of {otherThing}. Wanted to run something by you.\n\nI hope you'll forgive me, but I creeped you/your site quite a bit, and know that {anotherThing} is important to you guys (or at least I'm assuming this given the focus on {fourthThing}). I put something together a few months ago that I think could help. To make a long story short, it's an outreach system that uses AI to find people hiring website devs. Then pitches them with templates (actually makes them a demo website). Costs just a few cents to run, very high converting, and I think it's in line with {someImpliedBeliefTheyHave}"
}
```

## Rules

- Write in a spartan/laconic tone of voice.
- Make sure to use the above format when constructing your icebreakers. We wrote it this way on purpose.
- Shorten the company name wherever possible (say, "XYZ" instead of "XYZ Agency"). More examples:
  - "Love AMS" instead of "Love AMS Professional Services"
  - "Love Mayo" instead of "Love Mayo Inc."
- Do the same with locations.
  - "San Fran" instead of "San Francisco"
  - "BC" instead of "British Columbia"
- For your variables, focus on small, non-obvious things to paraphrase. The idea is to make people think we *really* dove deep into their website, so don't use something obvious. Do not say cookie-cutter stuff like "Love your website!" or "Love your take on marketing!".

## Profile

My name is Karim Nabil, AI Product Manager.

/*=============================================
=      Blog Contact Form Style (CF7)         =
=============================================*/

.blog-contact-form {
  margin-top: 60px;
  padding: 40px;
  background: #f9f9f9;
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
}

.blog-contact-form input,
.blog-contact-form select,
.blog-contact-form textarea {
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid #ccc;
  padding: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-family: inherit;
}

.blog-contact-form input[type="submit"] {
  background-color: #15008b;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  padding: 14px 32px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: 0.3s ease;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.blog-contact-form input[type="submit"]:hover {
  background-color: #1e0ab8;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .blog-contact-form {
    padding: 25px;
    margin-top: 40px;
  }
}

/*=============================================
=      Blog Contact Form Style (CF7)         =
=============================================*/

.blog-contact-form {
  margin-top: 60px;
  padding: 40px;
  background: #f9f9f9;
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
}

.blog-contact-form input,
.blog-contact-form select,
.blog-contact-form textarea {
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid #ccc;
  padding: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-family: inherit;
}

.blog-contact-form input[type="submit"] {
  background-color: #15008b;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  padding: 14px 32px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: 0.3s ease;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.blog-contact-form input[type="submit"]:hover {
  background-color: #1e0ab8;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .blog-contact-form {
    padding: 25px;
    margin-top: 40px;
  }
}

.blog-contact-form {
  margin-top: 60px;
  padding: 40px;
  background: #f9f9f9;
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
}

.blog-contact-form input,
.blog-contact-form select,
.blog-contact-form textarea {
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid #ccc;
  padding: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-family: inherit;
}

.blog-contact-form input[type="submit"] {
  background-color: #15008b;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  padding: 14px 32px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: 0.3s ease;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.blog-contact-form input[type="submit"]:hover {
  background-color: #1e0ab8;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .blog-contact-form {
    padding: 25px;
    margin-top: 40px;

At CONNECT Professional Services, we work with our customers to address the challenges associated with IT technology deployment. Starting from developing the IT strategy that can support your long-term business goals till realizing your IT objectives, we collaborate with you to address risks, assure compliance, improve agility, and unlock the desired outcomes. 

## Clear Vision for IT Strategy

We help our customers to develop a clear vision for the IT strategy and confidently tackle technology-related decisions. We stay on top of most recent developments and separate daily technology hype from strategic investments which deliver enduring results.
  
  
## Assessment and Optimization

We assist customers to have a deep insight of their IT architecture to evaluate its capacity, availability and scalability against world-class best practices. This allow customers to proactively address performance issues, deploy new services with confidence and make justifiable investment decisions.
  
  
## Integration and Change Management

Every IT landscape must change over time, and businesses expect the services provided by the IT systems to allow rapid changes to meet evolving business requirements without compromising availability. From another perspective, every new technology implementation is going to have to connect with existing systems, which usually introduce significant challenges. We work with our customers to define successful change management framework to ensure that the evolution of IT facilitates rapid development with smooth integration while minimizing disruption to ongoing operations.
  
  
## Key Features and Benefits

* Develop a clear vision for your IT strategy that is separated from daily technology hype.
* Assessment of your existing IT infrastructure to identify areas for improvements.
* Get the most of your IT investment.
* IT project scoping and optimization.
* Integrate new technologies within your running environment with confidence.
* Manage change to facilitate rapid development and roll-out of new services while minimizing disruption to ongoing operations.
